issues: 四块面板内容全是灰色骨架条，暂停任一帧都看不出是什么页面
面板用 1.5px 蓝灰实色描边 + 单层重投影，像线框稿而不像浮在桌面上的界面
胶囊是暗沉的蓝灰色，顶部白色 shine 是一块硬边矩形，玻璃感廉价
光标是 CSS 三角形拼的，指向和造型都不像真实指针
换位时整条轨道硬平移，没有速度感；胶囊与面板完全同步，像一张贴图
changes: 四种页型改为出版级假 UI：定价三栏（$12/$36/$84 + 权益清单 + 按钮）、Analytics 指标卡 + 渐变面积折线、服务状态表（Healthy/Degraded chip）、Workspace 设置表单 + 成员开关；DesignStage 改 raster=zoom，小字按成片分辨率栅格化
面板改为发丝线外框 + 顶部内高光 + 两层软阴影，离心越远阴影越低（elevation 18→6），脚下加一抹地面暗影
胶囊换成 fixture 同款靛蓝 #5b63d3 三档渐变、固定宽度 104，玻璃高光收窄并裁进圆角；文案换成 Pricing / Analytics / Status / Settings
换位时按轨道速度加横向 SpeedBlur（静止为 0）；胶囊混入 3f 前的轨道位置，比面板晚约 2f 落定形成跟随
光标换成矢量 macOS 指针，停在末位胶囊右缘内侧，到位时胶囊做一次 8f hover 提亮/微抬；背景改为极淡靛蓝雾霭 + 暗角 + 细颗粒
issuesEn: All four panels were grey skeleton bars; pausing on any frame you could not tell what page it was
Panels had a 1.5px solid blue-grey outline plus one heavy shadow, reading as a wireframe rather than UI floating over a desk
Pills were a dull blue-grey and the white shine was a hard-edged rectangle, so the gloss looked cheap
The cursor was a CSS triangle hack whose shape and angle did not read as a real pointer
Swaps were a rigid translation with no sense of speed, and pills moved in lockstep with panels like one bitmap
changesEn: Four page types became publication-grade mock UI: three-tier pricing, analytics KPIs with a gradient area chart, a service status table with Healthy/Degraded chips, and a workspace settings form with member toggles; DesignStage uses raster=zoom so small text rasterizes at output resolution
Panels get a hairline edge, top inner highlight and two-layer soft shadow that lowers with distance from center (elevation 18→6), plus a faint floor shadow
Pills use the fixture indigo #5b63d3 in three stops at a fixed 104 width, with a narrower gloss clipped to the rounded edge; labels are now Pricing / Analytics / Status / Settings
Velocity-driven horizontal SpeedBlur on the track during swaps (zero at rest); pills blend in the track position from 3f earlier so they settle about 2f after the panels
Vector macOS pointer that rests inside the last pill's right edge, triggering an 8f hover brighten/lift; background is a faint indigo haze with vignette and fine grain
